Package service

Class AdminServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
service.AdminServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AdminService
public class AdminServiceImpl extends Object implements AdminService
In-memory implementation of AdminService.

This service handles all administrator operations such as: authentication, managing books and users, and sending reminder notifications using the Observer design pattern.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Admin login/logout management
  • Book collection management
  • User registration and removal
  • Observer-based overdue reminder notifications

Related Sprints:

  • Sprint 1: Book management
  • Sprint 3: Reminder notifications (Observer pattern)
  • Sprint 4: Unregister user rules

    • unregisterUser

      public void unregisterUser(user u) throws IllegalStateException
      Unregisters a user from the system.

      A user cannot be unregistered if:

      • Admin is not logged in
      • User does not exist
      • User is an admin
      • User has active loans
      • User has unpaid fines
      Violations result in an IllegalStateException.
      Specified by:
      unregisterUser in interface AdminService
      Parameters:
      u - the user to unregister
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if removal conditions are not met

    • sendReminders

      public void sendReminders()
      Sends overdue reminder notifications to all members who have at least one unreturned and overdue loan.

      Observers such as EmailNotifier receive notifications for each overdue member.

      Specified by:
      sendReminders in interface AdminService
